70693-the-writings-of-origen-vol-2-of-2.title: The Writings Of Origen Vol 2 Of 2
70693-the-writings-of-origen-vol-2-of-2.creator: Unknown
70693-the-writings-of-origen-vol-2-of-2.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Asserts that the miracles of Christianity were performed by means of the invocation of demons: Answer—chap. That Christianity is a secret system of belief: Answer—chap. Maintains that a man should die for his belief; inconsistency of this with his profession as an Epicurean—chap. Maintains that reason ought to be the guide of men in adopting opinions, and charges Christians with inculcating a blind belief: Answer—chaps.

arxiv-2205-06160.title: Localized Vision-Language Matching for Open-vocabulary Object Detection
arxiv-2205-06160.creator: María A. Bravo, Sudhanshu Mittal, Thomas Brox
arxiv-2205-06160.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by María A. Bravo, Sudhanshu Mittal, Thomas Brox. In this work, we propose an open-vocabulary object detection method that, based on image-caption pairs, learns to detect novel object classes along with a given set of known classes. It is a two-stage training approach that first uses a location-guided image-caption matching technique to learn class labels for both novel and known classes in a weakly-supervised manner and second specializes the model for the object detection task using known class annotations.

arxiv-2206-06163.title: Effect of quartic-quintic beyond-mean-field interactions on a self-bound dipolar droplet Journal: Commun. Nonlinear Sci. Numer. Simul.
arxiv-2206-06163.creator: Luis E. Young-S, S. K. Adhikari
arxiv-2206-06163.description: Abstract We study the effect of beyond-mean-field quantum-fluctuation (QF) Lee-Huang-Yang (LHY) and three-body interactions, with quartic and quintic nonlinearities, respectively, on the formation of a stable self-repulsive (positive scattering length a a ) and a self-attractive (negative a a ) self-bound dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) droplet in free space under the action of two-body contact and dipolar interactions.

arxiv-2206-11299.title: Latent Policies for Adversarial Imitation Learning
arxiv-2206-11299.creator: Tianyu Wang, Nikhil Karnwal, Nikolay Atanasov
arxiv-2206-11299.description: Abstract This paper considers learning robot locomotion and manipulation tasks from expert demonstrations. Generative adversarial imitation learning (GAIL) trains a discriminator that distinguishes expert from agent transitions, and in turn use a reward defined by the discriminator output to optimize a policy generator for the agent.

arxiv-2208-01894.title: Synthetic ngVLA line observations of a massive star-forming cloud
arxiv-2208-01894.creator: M. Juvela, E. Mannfors, T. Liu, L.V. Tóth
arxiv-2208-01894.description: Abstract Context. Studies of the interstellar medium and the pre-stellar cloud evolution require spectral-line observations that have high sensitivity and high angular and velocity resolution. Regions of high-mass star formation are particularly challenging, because of line-of-sight confusion, inhomogeneous physical conditions, and potentially very high optical depths. Aims.

arxiv-2305-06693.title: Interpreting the GeV-TeV Gamma-Ray Spectra of Local Giant Molecular Clouds using GEANT4 Simulation
arxiv-2305-06693.creator: and Ritabrata Sarkar
arxiv-2305-06693.description: Abstract Recently, the Fermi-LAT gamma-ray satellite has detected six Giant Molecular Clouds (GMCs) located in the Gould Belt and the Aquila Rift regions. In half of these objects (Taurus, Orion A, Orion B), the observed gamma-ray spectrum can be explained using the Galactic diffused Cosmic Ray (CR) interactions with the gas environments.

arxiv-2310-03942.title: Towards Distributed Quantum Computing by Qubit and Gate Graph Partitioning Techniques
arxiv-2310-03942.creator: Marc G. Davis 1 , Joaquin Chung 2 , Dirk Englund 1,3 , Rajkumar Kettimuthu 2
arxiv-2310-03942.description: Abstract Distributed quantum computing is motivated by the difficulty in building large-scale, individual quantum computers. To solve that problem, a large quantum circuit is partitioned and distributed to small quantum computers for execution. Partitions running on different quantum computers share quantum information using entangled Bell pairs.

arxiv-2312-08800.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Health-related Queries with Presuppositions
arxiv-2312-08800.creator: Navreet Kaur, Monojit Choudhury, Danish Pruthi
arxiv-2312-08800.description: Abstract As corporations rush to integrate large language models (LLMs) to their search offerings, it is critical that they provide factually accurate information, that is robust to any presuppositions that a user may express. In this work, we introduce UPHILL, a dataset consisting of health-related queries with varying degrees of presuppositions.

arxiv-2402-08729.title: The Nature and Evolution of Early Massive Quenched Galaxies in the Simba-C Simulation 2024 The Nature and Evolution of Early Massive Quenched Galaxies in the Simba-C Simulation – 11
arxiv-2402-08729.creator: Jakub Szpila, Romeel Davé, Douglas Rennehan, Weiguang Cui, Renier T. Hough
arxiv-2402-08729.description: Abstract We examine the nature, origin, and fate of early ( z ≥ 2 z\geq 2 ) massive ( M ⋆ > 10 10 ​ M ⊙ M_{\star}>10^{10}M_{\odot} ) quenched galaxies (EQGs) in a new ( 100 ​ h − 1 ​ Mpc 3 ) (100h^{-1}{\rm Mpc}^{3}) run of the Simba-C galaxy formation model.

arxiv-2403-19142.title: A Tulu Resource for Machine Translation
arxiv-2403-19142.description: Abstract We present the first parallel dataset for English–Tulu translation. Tulu, classified within the South Dravidian linguistic family branch, is predominantly spoken by approximately 2.5 million individuals in southwestern India. Our dataset is constructed by integrating human translations into the multilingual machine translation resource FLORES-200. Furthermore, we use this dataset for evaluation purposes in developing our English–Tulu machine translation model.

arxiv-2411-08552.title: Leveraging Pre-Trained Neural Networks to Enhance Machine Learning with Variational Quantum Circuits
arxiv-2411-08552.creator: Jun Qi, Chao-Han Yang, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Pin-Yu Chen, Hector Zenil, Jesper Tegner
arxiv-2411-08552.description: Abstract Quantum Machine Learning (QML) offers tremendous potential but is currently limited by the availability of qubits. We introduce an innovative approach that utilizes pre-trained neural networks to enhance Variational Quantum Circuits (VQC). This technique effectively separates approximation error from qubit count and removes the need for restrictive conditions, making QML more viable for real-world applications.

arxiv-2509-07429.creator: Weimin Chen
arxiv-2509-07429.description: Abstract . arxiv-2512-23405.title: On the Sample Complexity of Learning for Blind Inverse Problems
arxiv-2512-23405.creator: Nathan Buskulic, Luca Calatroni, Lorenzo Rosasco, Silvia Villa
arxiv-2512-23405.description: Abstract Blind inverse problems arise in many experimental settings where the forward operator is partially or entirely unknown. In this context, methods developed for the non-blind case cannot be adapted in a straightforward manner. Recently, data-driven approaches have been proposed to address blind inverse problems, demonstrating strong empirical performance and adaptability.

pmc-10704999.title: Effects of the Novel Coronavirus Pandemic on the Identification and Care of Critically Ill Emergency Patients Not Infected with COVID-19
pmc-10704999.creator: Ming-Yue Zhu, Rong Li, Jie Xu, Fei She, Xin Du, Wei Zhang
pmc-10704999.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveTo clarify variations of diagnosis and treatment in the emergency care of critically ill patients not infected with novel coronavirus (COVID-19) prior to and amidst the COVID-19 pandemic.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted to compare and analyze the diagnosis and treatment data of critically ill patients with non-COVID-19 infection who were admitted to the emergency department of the Fourth Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital from January 2019 to November 2022.

pmc-11285406.title: Opioid free analgesia after return home in ambulatory colonic surgery patients: a single-center observational study
pmc-11285406.creator: Marilyn Gosgnach, Philippe Chasserant, Mathieu Raux
pmc-11285406.description: BackgroundBecause of the adverse effects of morphine and its derivatives, non-opioid analgesia procedures are proposed after outpatient surgery. Without opioids, the ability to provide quality analgesia after the patient returns home may be questioned. We examined whether an opioid-free strategy could ensure satisfactory analgesia after ambulatory laparoscopic colectomy.

pmc-11338610.title: Phylogenetic analysis of Staphylococcus aureus enterotoxin A gene in Iraqi breed cows with bovine mastitis: Implications for disease management
pmc-11338610.creator: Alaa Jawad, Sabreen Noori Dagman, Mohammed Mahdi Yaseen, Hassan Al-Karagoly
pmc-11338610.description: Background:Although milk is nutritionally valuable, it also serves as a significant medium for the transmission of pathogens and their toxins.Aim:This study aimed to investigate the role of enterotoxin gene A (SEA) in the development of bovine mastitis. We accomplished this by examining milk through polymerase chain reaction (PCR) testing, amino acid substitution analysis, and phylogenetic analysis.

pmc-11355848.title: Sleep Quality and Bariatric Surgery—Can We Treat Sleep Disturbances and Insomnia in Patients with Obesity with Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy?
pmc-11355848.creator: Krzysztof Wyszomirski, Antonina Ślubowska, Jan Dębski, Klaudia Skibiak, Józef Przybyłowski, Maria Czerwińska, Maciej Walędziak, Anna Różańska-Walędziak, Giuseppe Nisi
pmc-11355848.description: Introduction: Bariatric surgery is the mainstay of treatment of obesity, with a proven, long-lasting effect on body weight reduction and remission of co-morbidities. Sleep disorders, including insomnia, and deteriorated sleep quality and duration are associated with obesity, and a reduction in body weight can be associated with a reduction in prevalence of sleep disorders.

pmc-11436943.title: RETRACTED ARTICLE: Microstructure and dry sliding wear evaluation of functionally graded coating deposited via atmospheric plasma spray
pmc-11436943.creator: M Sathish, N Radhika, Bassiouny Saleh
pmc-11436943.description: Surfaces are commonly enhanced with wear-resistant coatings to improve their resistance to abrasion, erosion, and other forms of wear. These coatings play a crucial role in extending the lifespan and improving the performance of materials and components exposed to challenging conditions.

pmc-11507382.title: Shaping Public Servant Well-Being: Lessons from Brazil’s SIASS Program
pmc-11507382.creator: Marcos Massaki Imamura, Gabrielly de Queiroz Pereira, José Roberto Herrera Cantorani, Luiz Alberto Pilatti, Iffath Syed
pmc-11507382.description: This study aims to identify how the health and well-being of public servants are promoted and managed at the Federal University of Technology—Paraná (UTFPR). The Integrated Subsystem for Attention to the Health of Public Servants (SIASS), established by the federal government in 2009, is an initiative that integrates health actions, work safety, and social assistance.

pmc-11614181.title: Histopathological evaluation and grading for prostate cancer: current issues and crucial aspects
pmc-11614181.creator: Vittorio Agosti, Enrico Munari
pmc-11614181.description: A crucial aspect of prostate cancer grading, especially in low- and intermediate-risk cancer, is the accurate identification of Gleason pattern 4 glands, which includes ill-formed or fused glands. However, there is notable inconsistency among pathologists in recognizing these glands, especially when mixed with pattern 3 glands. This inconsistency has significant implications for patient management and treatment decisions.

pmc-12484039.title: Nicorandil reduces the antimicrobial effectiveness of polymyxin E against Klebsiella pneumoniae by decreasing reactive oxygen species accumulation
pmc-12484039.creator: Rongqing Zhu, Fangxin Luo, Chenxi Yuan, Ziqian Fang, Yaqin Guo, Bao Meng, Dongmei Zhao, Yanyan Liu, Yi Yang, Yasheng Li, Jiabin Li, Liang Yu
pmc-12484039.description: Nitric oxide (NO) plays a crucial role in bacterial physiology and survival, particularly in relation to antibiotic resistance. The protective role of NO against antibiotics is intricate, and the potential antagonistic interactions between NO donors and polymyxin E remain largely unexplored.

pmc-13073216.title: Effects of Controlled Atmosphere Conditions on the Quality Characteristics, Physicochemical and Antioxidant Properties of Pork Bone Broth
pmc-13073216.creator: Ying Su, Junli Dong, Qian Deng, Long Zhang, Jing Li, Jie Chen
pmc-13073216.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Controlled atmosphere (CA) is widely employed to preserve perishable foods, yet its potential effects on the quality of thermally processed bone broth remain poorly understood. This work systematically investigated the influences of ventilation time (0, 1, and 3 s), ventilation frequency (30, 60, 90, and 110 cycles), and cooking duration (25, 30, 38, and 45 min) on the overall quality of pork bone broth. A single-factor experimental design was adopted with three replications per treatment.

pmc-13139770.title: Adipocyte‐specific FFA2 deletion leads to increased adipose inflammation and is associated with altered intestinal lipid handling in mice
pmc-13139770.creator: Chioma Nnyamah, James Boyett, Barton Wicksteed, Nupur Pandya, Kai Xu, Irene Corona‐Avila, Nadia Sweis, Marissa St. George, Laura J. Den Hartigh, Abeer M. Mahmoud, Yuwei Jiang, Jose Cordoba‐Chacon, Medha Priyadarshini, Brian T. Layden
pmc-13139770.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Obesity and related metabolic disorders are often characterized by chronic adipose tissue inflammation, driving systemic insulin resistance and general metabolic dysfunction. Free Fatty Acid Receptor 2 (FFA2) has emerged as a potential modulator of adipocyte function, inflammation, and metabolism. To investigate the role of FFA2 expressed in the adipose tissue, we generated adipose‐specific FFA2 knockout mice (Adipoq‐F2‐KO) and assessed metabolic outcomes under standard laboratory chow and high‐fat, high‐sugar Western diet conditions, with and without dietary fiber supplementation.
